body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Materials Microstructure Evolution Simulator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Phase-field grain growth and solidification). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Phase-field grain growth and solidification and Recrystallization and precipitation kinetics. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Computational materials modeling software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
